notes:
Fixes the freezing and long pauses when a tablet has a role set but no partner connected. Opening a piece, or going in and out of edit mode, could stall for seconds and then catch up all at once - and sometimes stopped responding altogether. The tablet was doing an enormous amount of unnecessary work trying to send updates to a partner that was not there.

That same problem turned out to be behind two others that looked separate. Hiding a page on one tablet now reaches the other properly, instead of leaving both showing the same page, and everything keeps up better while paired.

Also in this update: writing on the second tablet no longer disappears when you leave edit mode (you used to have to turn the page and come back to see it again); the page-turn strip width, the stylus-hover setting and the pen feedback settings now follow from the main tablet to the second one; the pen's haptic setting is remembered and put back if something resets it; and the undo and redo icons are redrawn.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
